name: Electric Power-Assisted Cycle
description: An e-bike: a cycle with pedals, handlebars, no more than three wheels and electric motors totalling 500 W or less that stop assisting at 32 km/h, the old federal power-assisted bicycle written into territorial law.

restrictions.rule: Handlebars, pedals, no more than three wheels, and can be propelled by muscular power
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicles Act, R.S.Y. 2002, c. 153, s. 1

restrictions.rule: Electric-only motors with a total continuous power output rating of 500 W or less that can't assist past 32 km/h on level ground; assistance stops when pedalling stops or, with a throttle, when the brakes are applied
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicles Act, R.S.Y. 2002, c. 153, s. 1

restrictions.rule: Needs a separate motor on/off switch or a lockout below 3 km/h, a brake for each wheel or axle, gears that can't be changed once the motor is on, and a manufacturer's label saying what it is
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicles Act, R.S.Y. 2002, c. 153, s. 1

restrictions.rule: Rides as near as practicable to the right edge of the roadway, single file, both hands on the handlebars, and not where signs prohibit cycles
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicles Act, R.S.Y. 2002, c. 153, ss. 213 and 215

restrictions.rule: Carries only as many people as it's designed for, each on a regular seat
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicles Act, R.S.Y. 2002, c. 153, s. 213

restrictions.rule: Needs a headlamp, a red tail lamp and a red rear reflector at night, and a brake able to skid the wheel
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicles Act, R.S.Y. 2002, c. 153, s. 217

restrictions.rule: No territorial helmet requirement or minimum age, though the Act lets Cabinet set a minimum age by regulation
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicles Act, R.S.Y. 2002, c. 153, s. 123.02

restrictions.rule: Not ridden on a sidewalk or boulevard except at a vehicle crossing or where a municipal bylaw allows it
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicles Act, R.S.Y. 2002, c. 153, s. 145

restrictions.rule: Municipalities set their own e-bike rules: Whitehorse's E-Bike Regulation Bylaw 2021-22 requires a bicycle helmet, limits throttle e-bikes to some trails and bike lanes, and keeps e-bikes off most sidewalks
An excluded motor vehicle, not a motor cycle or off-road vehicle: no operator's licence, registration or insurance
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicles Act, R.S.Y. 2002, c. 153, s. 1
